1. Extend the channel with the border mode and take its FFT.
2. Build the tiles, smooth masks whose squares add up to 1 at every frequency.
3. To keep one direction, multiply the spectrum by the sum of the squared masks of the kept tiles and transform back.
4. To remove noise, for each tile multiply the spectrum by its mask and transform back to get its coefficients.
5. Set the coefficients below the factor times the noise of the tile to 0. Keep the coarse low-pass tile as it is.
6. Transform each tile back, multiply by its mask again, add all tiles and transform back.
7. Cut the result back to the image.
